text:
morgan: Heads-up: launching a small canary for a new header `X-RI-Route-Broker` (JSON) to centralize routing + quota hints. Need SDK owners on board for opt-in.

ravi: Clarify migration path: additive only? fallback to Route-Hint?

morgan: Yes, additive. Broker wins if present; otherwise legacy `Route-Hint` used. Canary first, then flip.

tess: SDK contract idea: accept either string or object for `route_broker`. If string, wrap to {"route": <string>}. Add opt-in flag `enable_route_broker=false` and env var support.

ravi: Telemetry: emit `sdk.route_broker.handshake` with sdk/version/opted_in. Also emit `sdk.route_broker.warn_parse` when coercion occurs. Console needs a tile for adoption and a comparison chart for quota enforcement deltas.

console-bot: We'll add "Broker adoption" tile and tag traces with a non-PII `client_id` from broker payload for correlation. Ingestion mapping ready to accept `sdk.route_broker.handshake`.

morgan: Server team will add `GET /v1/route-broker/debug` (internal) to echo parse results. Deploy canary 03:30 UTC tomorrow, 5% traffic, 2-week window. Rollback if quota mismatch > 3% or 5xxs spike > 1.5x.

deploy-bot: scheduled: route-broker v0.1-canary -> infra-canary. Rollback conditions annotated.

tess: Action items: open SDK PRs (py/go/ts) with tests + examples, add changelog entries, docs with snippet, and env var. Ravi -> migration doc & runbook. Console-bot -> dashboard tile.

morgan: Thanks, keep messages tight in PRs to speed review. :thumbsup:

(End)
